key_points: Stock near 52‑week low and trading below 50‑day SMA signals short‑term weakness.
Valuation discounts (P/E 17.7x vs S&P 22.5x) attract value investors but reflect slower growth expectations.
Job cuts at US bottling plant highlight cost‑cutting but may signal soft demand.
Paper‑flex packaging partnership shows sustainability focus, a long‑term positive.
Defensive dividend status could draw income‑seeking investors if rates stay high.
